messages.content: What is the effect of economic status on happiness levels?

function.name: get_happiness_index
function.description: Fetches the happiness index for a given country or area based on data compiled from global surveys. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to retrieve the happiness index.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the happiness index.

demographic_group.description: The demographic group for which to retrieve the happiness index. If not specified, the total for all groups will be returned.

message.content: Economic status—often measured by income level or socioeconomic class—has a strong and consistent influence on happiness. In most studies, people in higher income brackets report higher life satisfaction and well‑being than those in lower brackets. This relationship is usually strongest when comparing the extremes (e.g., low‑income vs. high‑income groups). However, the effect tends to plateau at middle‑income levels: once basic needs are met, additional income brings diminishing returns for overall happiness. Income also interacts with other factors such as social support, health, and personal values, so its impact can vary across cultures and individual circumstances.
message.reasoning: The user asks about the effect of economic status on happiness levels. We need to provide an answer. The user didn't specify a country or year. We can give a general explanation.
